headline: SPR Auto files status of outstanding non-convertible debentures
hook: Routine debt disclosure for SPR Auto
summary: SPR Auto Technologies Limited has submitted a mandatory disclosure to the NSE regarding its outstanding non-convertible debentures (NCDs). The filing details the specific ISINs for debt issued on a private placement basis as of September 30, 2026. This is a standard regulatory compliance filing required for companies with listed debt instruments.
